data.name: Bimol
data.gender_notes: Bimol is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bimol is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'bimba', meaning moon. The name signifies the illumination and brightness of the moon. The name Bimol carries the meaning “Moonlight, Illumination” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bimol usually hope their child will grow to embody moonlight, illumination and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Bimol belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moonlight, Illumination.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bimol total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: Bimol holds significant cultural meaning in Hindu traditions, where the moon is considered a divine deity. The name Bimol is believed to bestow the much-adored and cherished quality of brightness and illumination, just like the full moon. It is often given as a name to boys born during the seven nights of the moon's fullness.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Bimol holds spiritual significance as a reminder of the inner radiance and illumination that we all possess. It serves as a constant reminder that, just like the moon reflects the light of the sun, we too can reflect the light of our inner divine self in our daily lives. The name Bimol offers a connection to the divine energy of the cosmos and can inspire one to strive for inner peace, happiness, and enlightenment. Each time the name is spoken aloud, it serves as a reminder of the inner light that shines within all of us.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Bimol, derived from the Sanskrit word 'bimba' meaning 'reflection' or 'image', signifies the embodiment of divinity in an individual. It is a reminder of one's inner divine self, urging self-realization and spiritual growth.
